payload.reason: The evidence discusses a nonsymbolic text representation model that does not rely on traditional segmentation or tokenization methods, suggesting that it defines units and contexts in a novel way without needing symbolic units like words.

claims.text: The model introduces a nonsymbolic approach to text representation that does not require segmentation or tokenization into traditional units like words.
The definition of units and contexts is achieved through methods that do not rely on segmentation boundaries, indicating an elementary unit of text can be defined nonsymbolically.
